text:
Andrea (devex): Heads-up — we have an embargoed changelog for the upcoming SDK cut. Do not publish release notes until 2024-12-05 00:00 UTC. Keeping canary out to catch regressions.
Sam (release-engineer): timeline acknowledged. publishing window 23:45-00:15 UTC. planning pin flip at 00:00 UTC. any objections?
Marco (pm): fine from product side, embargo is for partner announcement.
Jiayi (eng-platform): quick check — are we doing simultaneous py/ts? Need to coordinate `twine` + `npm` steps. Also need runtime-matrix report.
Sam (release-engineer): yes. plan: 1) publish py canary to pypi staging 23:50, 2) publish js canary to npm @canary 23:52, smoke tests 23:55, pin flip 00:00, then release notes unmask at 00:00.
Lina (qa): I'll run smoke suite during window. If flakiness > 2 fails, we hold and rollback. Test steps:
```
pytest tests/smoke/test_integration.py -k publish
npm run test:smoke -- --package redwood-sdk-js@canary
```
Sam (release-engineer): Deploy bot will post status. tagging `@oncall` just in case.
deploy-bot: Starting publish job redwood-sdk-py@1.4.0-canary -> pypi-staging
deploy-bot: Starting publish job redwood-sdk-js@1.4.0-canary -> npm-canary
Andrea (devex): Changelog file is in `changelogs/1.4.0-embargo.md` — DO NOT merge or open until release time. Please avoid copying into marketing.
Marco (pm): Also remember we need to add deprecation note for the legacy sync API in both SDKs. Draft is in google doc: (link)
Sam (release-engineer): If publish fails, we'll fall back to `stable` pin for 24h and iterate. Rollback criteria: >5% error increase on main routes or smoke failing. Lina pls confirm.
Lina (qa): Confirmed. I'll post results in this thread.
Jiayi (eng-platform): Also verify package signing for Py. Command: `gpg --detach-sign dist/*` — we need keys loaded on CI.
Sam (release-engineer): CI shows keys OK. Proceeding with canaries in 10m.
Andrea (devex): Reminder: for enterprise customers on Dedicated we've scheduled a 48h pin window post-release. Engineering Ops will flip routing only after pin window unless critical.
Marco (pm): Agree.
deploy-bot: redwood-sdk-py canary published -> success (23:51:12 UTC)
deploy-bot: redwood-sdk-js canary published -> success (23:52:03 UTC)
Lina (qa): smoke run started
Lina (qa): smoke run complete — all tests passed :thumbsup:
Sam (release-engineer): flipping pins to `1.4.0` at 00:00
Sam (release-engineer): command: `rbacctl rollout set-pin redwood-sdk --version 1.4.0 --scope public` will be executed
deploy-bot: pin flip initiated by Sam (23:59:58 UTC)
deploy-bot: pin flip success (00:00:01 UTC)
Andrea (devex): Unmask embargoed changelog and release notes now. Please crosspost to #marketing and #announcements.
Marco (pm): publishing release notes now. Also adding deprecation blurb for legacy sync API.
Sam (release-engineer): tagging rollback watch for 2 hours. If any sign of regression escalate to eng-sre.
Jiayi (eng-platform): monitor dashboards for 30m then scale down canary traces
Lina (qa): all clear 00:30 — no regressions observed
Andrea (devex): thanks team. leaving embargo note for next release: move changelog to /release/notes/ next time.
Sam (release-engineer): closing thread. :rocket:
